brief_text: ten dominoes stand in a row; the first is tipped over and knocks down the rest, and every domino ends tilted at least 15 degrees from upright

usage.text:

verdict.what_happens: Gravity tips domino1 into domino2 at 0.10 s. Successive collisions reach domino10 at 0.84 s, and all ten settle by about 1.25 s. At 6 s, domino1–domino9 are approximately 76 degrees from upright and domino10 is 90 degrees from upright.

usage.text:
The first domino starts tilted 10° and falls under gravity, contacting domino2 at 0.10 s. The chain reaction reaches domino10 at 0.84 s, and all ten settle by about 1.25 s.
